description: Assess latest quarterly results, revenue and PAT growth, margin movement, filing freshness, and narrative quality. Variant focus: quick scan; timeframe: last 3 months; response style: concise table.

sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_results AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (qr.symbol) qr.symbol, qr.period_end, qr.revenue, ra.pat,
    ra.growth_yoy_revenue_pct, ra.growth_qoq_revenue_pct,
    ra.growth_yoy_pat_pct, ra.growth_qoq_pat_pct, ra.verdict, ra.filing_date
  FROM scores.quarterly_results qr
  JOIN scores.results_analysis ra
    ON qr.symbol = ra.symbol
   AND qr.period_end = ra.period_end
  WHERE qr.period_type = 'quarter'
    AND qr.period_end > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
  ORDER BY qr.symbol, qr.period_end DESC NULLS LAST, ra.updated_at DESC
)
SELECT lr.symbol, sa.company_name, lr.revenue,
  lr.growth_yoy_revenue_pct, lr.growth_qoq_revenue_pct, lr.growth_yoy_pat_pct,
  lr.growth_qoq_pat_pct, lr.verdict
FROM latest_results lr
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots sa
  ON lr.symbol = sa.symbol
WHERE sa.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots);

sql_templates.description: Fetch insider alerts and bulk deals within the last 3 months with technical confirmation.
sql_templates.sql:
WITH recent_alerts AS (
    SELECT ia.symbol, ia.alert_date, ia.entity, ia.qty, ia.value_cr, ia.insider_score 
    FROM signals.insider_alerts ia 
    WHERE ia.alert_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
),
recent_deals AS (
    SELECT bd.symbol, bd.deal_date, bd.entity, bd.qty, bd.price 
    FROM signals.bulk_block_deals bd 
    WHERE bd.deal_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
),
latest_stages AS (
    SELECT ss.symbol, ss.trading_signal, ss.technical_score, ss.snapshot_date
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots ss
    WHERE ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
)
SELECT ra.symbol, ra.alert_date, ra.entity, ra.qty, ra.value_cr, ls.trading_signal, ls.technical_score 
FROM recent_alerts ra
JOIN latest_stages ls ON ra.symbol = ls.symbol
WHERE ls.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
UNION ALL
SELECT rd.symbol, rd.deal_date, rd.entity, rd.qty, rd.price, ls.trading_signal, ls.technical_score 
FROM recent_deals rd
JOIN latest_stages ls ON rd.symbol = ls.symbol
WHERE ls.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
LIMIT 50;

validation_rules: Ensure all filters strictly adhere to SQL templates.
Perform result set checks for authenticity and freshness.
